title: Cardano Summit 2023 NFT Hoodies - Verifiable Ownership Of Real World Merch

ms.promise: Design creation for Cardano Summit Hoodies. We will work with a freelance artist to create a unique design for the merch. This design has already been posted on social media and received a positive reaction from the Cardano Community. Here is the Google Drive for the design files. https://drive.google.com/file/d/15sSeB2aOmXP1yfVm59twJa9jDPpPlLpF/view?usp=sharing
ms.criteria: Completed designs for the hoodies. The hoodie design has been completed and available for public view here. The design has also been shared on the Kaizen Crypto social media channels to bring awareness to the proposal. While we are navigating approval from the Catalyst team, our team has already began and completed our first output. https://drive.google.com/file/d/15sSeB2aOmXP1yfVm59twJa9jDPpPlLpF/view?usp=sharing
ms.report:
We have successfully completed the design for the hoodie. We have printed 500 total hoodies using a local print company based in Dubai called Look At Me Print. Each Hoodie was individually marked to show it's size. We have also created a QR code leaflet which includes the corresponding NFT minted by NMKR. The hoodies were distributed at the Cardano Summit 2023 in Dubai and there was a great response from the Cardano community regarding this project. We have now successfully completed the scope of this project.

ms.promise:
The hoodies will be printed with the design. They will be stored appropriately indoors until the Cardano Summit. During the days of the Cardano Summit (Nov 2-4) the hoodies will be available to pickup by everyone who attends the event on a first come first served basis. 
As per our previous submission, we have decided to remove the Shopify Store element from the proposal. We are deciding not to sell the hoodies, but rather give them away for free. Seeing as our proposal was funded it seems fair to give this value back to the community. The overall outputs for the proposal remain intact, and we are certain the Cardano community will not mind getting something for free. The allocated budget which was intended for the original output will instead be used for the production costs (which are greater than the amount requested).
Please reference the below comments
"The proposal contains a budget line of 10,000 ADA specifically dedicated to “Shopify Store Creation”, however this is not mentioned in the milestone outputs. M2 seems like the moment that the store would need to go online. The M2 described in the proposal also includes “Hoodies can be purchased through an official site.”

ms.promise:
All recipients who received a hoodie will be able to claim an NFT which corresponds to the apparel they received during the Cardano Summit. 
All NFTs will be minted and contain metadata regarding the apparel type, highlighted event, and relevant links.
Some clarification regarding the proposal reviewers assessment. Please reference the following comments " Here information is given related to who picked up each hoodie. Data will be stored on the blockchain about these people, but for me it is very abstract how we are going to understand the real impact of this project for Cardano, beyond the distribution of the clothes itself "
We are not storing information related to anyone who claimed a hoodie. It is not our intention to track the individuals who claimed a hoodie. The intention of the NFT is for the owner to show 'proof of ownership' and have a digital collectible on Cardano which shows their participation of the Cardano Summit. The reviewer's comments are based on a misunderstood notion of our desired goal.
ms.criteria:
NFTs will be minted on the Cardano blockchain and available for anyone who received a hoodie to claim
A closeout report and video will be submitted after the Cardano Summit to disclose the number of hoodies distributed as well as number of NFTs claimed
Pictures will be shared on Twitter and reposted by the @KaizenCrypto profile to show proof of completion
